We extend standard LLM-as-a-Judge baselines with external validation tools based on web-search and code execution. We observe that the resulting system is often, but not always, able to improve performance (measured as agreement with ground-truth annotations) across a range of response domains that are typically challenging for LLM-as-a-Judge systems: (1) long-form factual, (2) advanced coding, and (3) math responses.
